title: ML Maths
logo: <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 26 26" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="1" y="1" width="24" height="24" rx="7" fill="var(--accent)"/><path d="M5.5 19.5Q13 0.5 20.5 19.5" fill="none" stroke="var(--accent-ink)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M6.5 10h13" stroke="var(--accent-ink)" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="0.1 3.2"/><circle cx="13" cy="10" r="2.6" fill="var(--accent-ink)"/></svg>
description: A self-study course in the maths behind machine learning: 47 lessons across sets, logic, linear algebra, calculus, probability and inference.
hero: The maths under machine learning, one lesson at a time.

modules.name: Sets
modules.desc: Use sets, operations, products, functions, and extrema as the precise language behind data domains and feature spaces.

modules.name: Logic
modules.desc: Translate mathematical claims, predicates, implications, and Boolean rules into exact truth conditions.

modules.name: Linear systems
modules.desc: Represent geometry and computation with vectors, determinants, elimination, inverses, and affine maps.

modules.name: Spaces
modules.desc: Understand the structure behind spans, subspaces, bases, coordinates, dimension, and rank.

modules.name: Spectral
modules.desc: Find invariant directions and simpler coordinate systems for repeated linear transformations.

modules.name: Projection
modules.desc: Use inner products and orthogonal decompositions to reason about distances, residuals, and least-squares geometry.

modules.name: Low rank
modules.desc: Connect curvature, singular values, and low-rank structure to denoising, compression, and representation learning.

modules.name: Applications
modules.desc: Apply linear algebra directly to least squares, regression, PCA, and model-fitting workflows.

modules.name: Calculus
modules.desc: Build the derivative, integral, and optimization tools behind gradients, loss surfaces, and continuous densities.

modules.name: Probability
modules.desc: Model uncertainty with events, random variables, transformations, expectations, and common distributions.

modules.name: Joint RVs
modules.desc: Move from one random variable to many, including marginals, conditionals, covariance, correlation, and Gaussian structure.

modules.name: Inference
modules.desc: Connect finite samples to model parameters with estimators, likelihoods, MLE, and confidence intervals.
